title.ko: 가정법 현재: suggest · insist · essential that + 동사원형
title.en: the mandative subjunctive: suggest, insist, essential that + base verb

explain.ko: 가정법 현재는 요구·제안·주장·필수성을 나타내는 격식 있는 문장에서 that절의 동사를 원형으로 쓰는 구문입니다. suggest, recommend, insist, demand, propose, request 같은 동사나 essential, vital, imperative 같은 형용사 뒤에서 쓰이며, 주어가 3인칭 단수여도 -s를 붙이지 않고 시제도 바뀌지 않습니다(It is essential that he attend). 부정은 not + 원형(that he not be late)입니다. 영국 영어에서는 should + 원형을 쓰기도 합니다.
explain.en: The mandative subjunctive uses the base verb in a that-clause after verbs and adjectives of demand, suggestion, insistence and necessity: suggest, recommend, insist, demand, propose, request, essential, vital, imperative. There is no -s for third-person singular and no tense change (It is essential that he attend). The negative is not + base verb (that he not be late). British English often uses should + base verb instead.

rows: 동사 + that + 원형 / verb + that + base
형용사 + that + 원형 / adjective + that + base
It is vital that he be informed.
I demand that he not leave.
We insisted that she should go.

notes.ko: that절의 동사는 시제나 주어에 따라 변하지 않습니다.
notes.en: The verb in the that-clause does not change with tense or subject.

notes.ko: be동사는 항상 be를 씁니다: It is essential that he be present.
notes.en: Be stays as be: It is essential that he be present.

notes.ko: 일상 대화에서는 should를 쓰거나 to부정사로 바꿔 말하는 경우가 많습니다.
notes.en: In everyday speech, should or an infinitive is often used instead.

task.model: The committee demanded that all applications be submitted by Friday. It is essential that the officer check the deadline in person. I propose that the documents be reviewed in advance. Every department must comply with this regulation.

model_trans.ko: 위원회는 모든 신청서가 금요일까지 제출되어야 한다고 요구했습니다. 담당자가 마감일을 직접 확인하는 것이 필수적입니다. 저는 지원 서류를 사전에 검토하도록 제안합니다. 모든 부서가 이 규정을 따라야 합니다.
model_trans.en: The committee demanded that all applications be submitted by Friday. It is essential that the officer check the deadline in person. I propose that the documents be reviewed in advance. Every department must comply with this regulation.
